sceneBrief: 1894 Gwangheungchang riverside grain warehouse closing: porters gathering the last straw rice sacks by a quiet timber storehouse, moored wooden cargo boat on the Sogang riverbank, officials in late Joseon dress. Not a modern memorial marker.
